## Submission or catalog change

Describe the add-on/version or maintenance change and link the submission file.

## Evidence and limitations

Link the pinned creator commit and evidence. Disclose required checks that are
failed, incomplete or unverified. Do not paste secrets or private creator files.

## Review

- [ ] Creator source and package remain in the creator repository.
- [ ] Every package reference uses a full commit SHA and repository-relative path.
- [ ] This change does not claim approval from creator reports alone.
- [ ] Ownership transfers, renames and version conflicts are disclosed.

The catalog is in bootstrap. Required validation and maintainer approval must be
implemented and complete before any add-on can be published as approved.
